pages.title: Restless Sleep
pages.text: A Traveler's sleeping bag can carry you through an ordinary night, but the rest is poor. After the night advances, Restless Sleep drains one full hunger icon and one full thirst icon every ten seconds for fifty seconds.

pages.title: A Rested Camp
pages.text: Avoid Restless Sleep beneath a complete tarp or inside a SimplyTents shelter, with a lit campfire and deployed Traveler's Backpack in range. The pack needs food worth more than 5 nutrition. Prepared Shelter appears while the camp is ready; food is consumed only when dawn advances.$(br2)Place a Radio Transmitter inside the shelter to establish a Camp Radio. Use it to inspect every camp requirement and open Survivor Network contracts.

pages.title: Build a Campsite
pages.text: Start with a complete overhead shelter: a Rotwire tarp or a supported SimplyTents shelter. Put a lit campfire, a deployed Traveler's Backpack, and a sleeping bag inside the same sheltered area. The backpack must contain food worth more than 5 nutrition.

pages.title: Shelter Checklist
pages.text: Keep the radio, sleeping bag, campfire, and deployed pack together. When the shelter is complete, the Camp Radio screen shows the missing requirement instead of leaving you to guess. Equipment outside the shelter does not satisfy the camp, even when it is only a few blocks away.

pages.title: SimplyTents Shelters
pages.text: Compact Tent, Small Tipi, Duo Tent, Large Tent, Tipi, and Yurt shelters are recognized by the camp system. The radio must be inside the same shelter volume as the sleeping bag and camp equipment; a nearby tent does not count.

pages.title: New Dawn
pages.text: Endure an entire night awake and New Dawn restores one full hunger icon and one full thirst icon every ten seconds for fifty seconds. You must be present from dusk to dawn. Sleeping, dying, leaving the dimension, logging in late, or another survivor skipping the night forfeits the reward.
